result.title: TrustMix: Graceful Degradation for Pretrained Models under Distribution Shift
result.summary: Predicting beyond the training domain necessarily requires assumptions about how the ground truth extrapolates, yet in most neural networks these assumptions are made only implicit through the architecture. We propose TrustMix, a lightweight post-hoc method that makes a pretrained model's extrapolative behaviour explicit and controllable. TrustMix combines the predictive distribution produced by a pretrained model with a user-specified fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$, such that as the out-of-distribution (OOD) deviation statistic grows, we collapse towards $p_0(y|x)$. TrustMix provides graceful degradation: the predictive distribution converges toward the fallback distribution as the OOD signal grows. The fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$ can reflect domain knowledge, if available, or rely on a domain-agnostic stationarity assumption. TrustMix does not require retraining of the base model and can be applied to both regression and classification problems. We evaluated TrustMix on several synthetic and real-world distribution shifts, including tabular, image, and natural language processing tasks. We tested TrustMix on datasets such as CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet and on numerous architectures including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformers. TrustMix remains competitive in-distribution while improving predictive uncertainty under distribution shift, with gains in predictive likelihood for regression and calibration for classification. Finally, we showed that TrustMix can provide useful predictive distributions for decision-making applications by utilizing it as a surrogate for Bayesian Optimisation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出轻量后处理方法 TrustMix：将预训练模型的预测分布与用户指定的回退分布按 OOD 偏离统计量混合，随分布偏移增大逐步收敛到回退分布，无需重训，并在表格、图像与自然语言任务上验证其校准与似然表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「随 OOD 信号增强而平滑退化为回退分布」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据失配时降低对外部输入的依赖、以及 STOP 与弃答决策提供可核查的连续置信度调控线索。
